# Ehroz (ehroz.pro)

> Ehroz (Эхроз) — designer and developer from Astana, Kazakhstan. ehroz.pro is the showcase of Ehroz’s small apps and tools for macOS, Windows and the web: converters, image compression, auto captions, transcription and image search. Russian is the main language (https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/), English is at https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/en/.

Contacts: Telegram @hhrrzz1 (https://t.me/hhrrzz1), email ehrozbekisharifzoda@gmail.com, GitHub https://github.com/ehroz1. Full text of every app page: https://ehroz1.github.io/llms-full.txt.

## Apps

- [Morfus](https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/en/morfus/): Radial file converter for macOS. macOS; status: Available, version 0.2.2. Russian: https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/morfus/
- [Morfu](https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/en/morfu/): Menu bar converter for macOS. macOS; status: Available, version 3.3. Russian: https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/morfu/
- [Pachaq](https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/en/pachaq/): Image compression and cropping for the web. macOS, Windows; status: Coming soon, version 0.1.1. Russian: https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/pachaq/
- [Sukhan](https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/en/sukhan/): Auto captions for Reels, TikTok and Shorts. macOS; status: In development. Russian: https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/sukhan/
- [radius](https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/en/radius/): Local background removal on Mac. macOS; status: In development. Russian: https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/radius/
- [BLA-БЛА](https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/en/bla-bla/): Audio & video transcription in the browser. Web; status: Available. Russian: https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/bla-bla/
- [Picta](https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/en/picta/): Search photos, icons and video everywhere at once. Web; status: Available. Russian: https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/picta/
- [PadBridge](https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/en/padbridge/): A gamepad in any game on Mac. macOS; status: Coming soon, version 0.4.0. Russian: https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/padbridge/
- [Moss Pocket](https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/en/moss-pocket/): Your Downloads, right next to the Dock. macOS; status: In development, version 0.1.0. Russian: https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/moss-pocket/
- [Peecube](https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/en/peecube/): Links in a window over the page. macOS, Extension; status: Coming soon, version 4.1. Russian: https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/peecube/
- [ANY CAMERA](https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/en/any-camera/): A video or photo instead of your webcam. Extension; status: Coming soon, version 1.0.0. Russian: https://ehroz1.github.io/ehroz.pro/any-camera/
